about.title: About the company
about.text: METALMAX is a modern full-cycle metalworking company. We combine professional experience, advanced technology, and modern equipment to handle tasks of any complexity. Our goal is long-term partnership and a flawless result for every client.

items.text: We've worked with METALMAX for years now. Consistently high quality, precise deadlines, and a professional approach to every project.
items.name: Andriy K.

items.text: We ordered a batch of metal structures for a warehouse — everything was made quickly, exactly to the drawings, no complaints.
items.name: Maryna S.

items.text: Very happy with the laser cutting and powder coating quality. We recommend them as a reliable partner.
items.name: Ihor P.

items.q: Which materials do you work with?
items.a: We process mild steel, stainless steel, aluminium, copper, and brass from 0.5 to 50 mm thick depending on the technology.
Up to 30 mm on laser equipment, up to 50 mm on plasma, depending on the metal type.

items.q: How long does an order take?
items.a: It depends on complexity and volume — from 1 business day for simple parts to several weeks for large projects.
Yes, we arrange delivery across Ukraine via our own transport or partner carriers.

items.q: Can you provide a quote from drawings?
items.a: Yes, send drawings in DXF, DWG, or PDF and we'll prepare a quote within 1 hour.
